payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_scheduler.py::test_an_orphaned_task_beside_another_head_on_its_branch_is_refused_not_resumed stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/scheduler.py. The claim was 'When the newest re-queueing task is `ORPHANED` and no `ORPHANED` row at its `spec_sha` carries a `pr_url`, `build_queue` refuses the spec as `open_pr_on_spec` beside a pull request no task owns. `gh` lists it open on the spec\'s branch. Its `headRefOid` is a non-empty sha no non-`ORPHANED` row at the `spec_sha` records as `pushed_sha`, and its url is no such row\'s `pr_url`. An `ORPHANED` row\'s push owns nothing. The reason names that url and does not say "another task". The scan asks `gh` for `headRefOid`. The witness drives one `ORPHANED` row with no push, the shape spec loop session 84 met, and the same row after a push. That row is refused beside a pull request at its own push. It resumes beside one on another branch, one with no `headRefOid`, and one with an empty one. After the row moves to `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, a pull request at another head no longer refuses it. A dead revision\'s rows come next. A `CHANGES_REQUESTED` row carries url U and push A, and a newer url-less, push-less `ORPHANED` row was minted above it. That row resumes beside U at head A, U at another head, and another url at head A, and is refused beside another url at another head. A newer `GATE_ERROR` row above an `ORPHANED` row resumes beside a foreign pull request, and a newest `ORPHANED` row above both refuses again. A newer url-less `ORPHANED` row is refused above a pushed url-less one, beside a pull request at that push. It is refused above an adopted one too, beside the adopted pull request at its push. Both scans read each case.', and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
